authentication.actor_principal_id: Audit echo of the verified CCT sub; mismatch is actor_mismatch. No body-only fallback.

issue_scim_token.oidc_pairing: Optional immutable same-organization Provider in token authorization. Omission creates an unpaired directory-only credential; existing tokens remain unpaired. The response represents no pairing as null.

upsert_oidc_provider.lifecycle: Provider identity is (organization_id, name). Issuer and Client ID are immutable; a replacement registration uses a new Provider name. Client-secret rotation is supported. Use set_oidc_provider_enabled to retire the old Provider; deletion is not supported.
upsert_oidc_provider.link_policy_update: On create, omitted policy uses none/[]/false. On update, omitted policy preserves all three values and the review flag. Explicit policy is complete; only acknowledge_link_policy_review=true clears the persistent legacy review flag.

set_oidc_provider_enabled.lifecycle: Changes only the local enabled state and never contacts the external Provider. Repeating the desired state is idempotent.

authorization.target_membership: Organization scope requires the Membership from the Console path; under locks the binding membership_id must match it exactly, otherwise not_found with no revocation or audit/feed effects. Self scope forbids this field.

user_profile.create_semantics: POST is create-only and conflicts with an active resource ID or organization-scoped externalId
user_profile.delete_semantics: hide SCIM membership and allow fresh reprovisioning on the same global User; create a new Membership and repoint durable OIDC identity while preserving audit facts

group_profile.create_semantics: POST is create-only and conflicts with an active resource ID or organization-scoped externalId

scim.authority: one logical directory authority per organization; bearer tokens are rotating credentials
